notes:
• ForgeQuest now coaches without AI: the finish screen, reminders, Home and the new Progress tab point out what is worth noticing from your own training.
• One record per exercise, and a finish screen shaped by the kind of day you had.
• 135 exercises and 19 stretches, each with form cues; 6 more starter plans and a lighter week every 4th week.
• 15 new badges, a calmer Home with today's workout up top, and barcode scanning in Food.
• AI is optional: use the Gemini app (recommended) or your own key in Settings. Groq and the weekly check-in are gone.
